# CosMx
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dbscan)
library(ggpubr)
library(cowplot)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)

domcol <- c( "gray13", "gold2", "lightskyblue2", "darkorange1", "plum4", "maroon")
names(domcol)<-6:1
cellcols<-c("#8DB600","#fdae61","#a95f96","#0067A5","#604E97",
            "#f46d43","hotpink","#BE0032","cornflowerblue","black")
names(cellcols)<-c("B cells","Plasma cells","CD4 T cells","CD8 T cells",
                   "NK cells","Myeloid cells","unknown","Epithelial","Stroma")
classcols = c( "Endometrium" = "#c2a5cf", 
              "Endometriosis" = "#b8e3ad")


files<-list.files()
files<-files[str_detect(files,"bgclus")]
files<-files[-1]
metadata<-lapply(files,data.table::fread)%>%bind_rows()
i<-metadata%>%distinct(Run_Tissue_name,dom_nEndoh1_75)%>%
  count(dom_nEndoh1_75)%>%filter(n==1)%>%
  select(dom_nEndoh1_75)%>%unlist()
metadata<-metadata%>%filter(dom_nEndoh1_75!=i&!fov_type%in%c("unknown","low_signal"))
```

## blob size
```{r}
metadata<-metadata%>%filter(dom_nEndoh1_75==6)

samples<-unique(metadata$Run_Tissue_name)
#per sample
#eye selected, how to automatize??????
#samples<-c("6318B1-PT20"=7,"BEME005-3042A1-PT11"=9,"BEME209-Endometrium"=25,#15,
#           "BEME228-9152C4-PT14"=21,"BEME518_Endometriosis_1023-A2"=17,"BEME523-Endometriosis"=12,
#           "BEME541_Endometriosis-795R3"=11,"BEME550-Endometrium"=1,"BEME596-Endometrium"=46)
dom6<-metadata%>%split(by="Run_Tissue_name")
eps<-c(.05,.03,.018,.018,.1,.045,.0135,.05,.021)#overfitted 
names(eps)<-samples
dbcl <- lapply(names(dom6),function(x)
    dbscan(dom6[[x]]%>%select(x_slide_mm,y_slide_mm), eps = eps[x]))
names(dbcl)<-names(dom6)
blobs<-lapply(names(dom6), function(x)
  dom6[[x]]%>%select(Run_Tissue_name,cell_ID,x_slide_mm,y_slide_mm,
                     Class,Area.um2,fov_type,dom_nEndoh1_75)%>%
    mutate(dbcl=dbcl[[x]]$cluster))%>%bind_rows()
#blobs%>%ggplot(aes(x=x_slide_mm,y=y_slide_mm,col=as.factor(dbcl)))+
#  geom_point(size=1)+
#  facet_wrap(~Run_Tissue_name,scales="free")+
#  guides(col = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5)))
blobs<-blobs%>%mutate(Class=str_replace(Class,".+ e","E"))%>%
              mutate(Class=factor(Class,levels=c("Endometrium","Endometriosis")))
pA0<-blobs%>%count(Class,Run_Tissue_name,dbcl,name="Size")%>%
    ggplot(aes(x=Size,fill=Class))+geom_histogram()+
    facet_wrap(~Class,ncol=1,scale="free_y",strip.position = "right")+
    theme_classic()+labs(y="Count")+
    theme(strip.background = element_blank())+scale_y_sqrt()+
    scale_fill_manual(values=classcols)+theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## blob composition
```{r}
temp<-blobs%>%filter(str_detect(fov_type,"B|CD|Mye|Plas|NK"))%>%
  count(Class,Run_Tissue_name,dbcl,fov_type,name="cells")%>%
  group_by(Class,Run_Tissue_name,dbcl)%>%
  mutate(total=sum(cells),prop=100*cells/total)%>%
  ungroup()

pB0<-temp%>%count(Class,fov_type)%>%
  left_join(temp%>%distinct(Class,Run_Tissue_name,dbcl)%>%
              count(Class,name = "total"))%>%mutate(prop=100*n/total)%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Class,y=prop,fill=fov_type))+geom_col()+facet_grid(~fov_type)+
    theme_classic()+theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                                strip.background = element_blank(),
                                plot.margin=grid::unit(c(0,0,-4,0), "mm"))+
    labs(x="",y="% of instances")+
  scale_fill_manual(values=cellcols)+theme(legend.position = "none")

pB1<-temp%>%ggplot(aes(x=Class,y=prop,col=fov_type,group=Class))+
    geom_violin()+
    geom_jitter(aes(size=total),width = .1,alpha=0.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values=cellcols)+
    stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test",label="p.signif",
                       hide.ns = T,comparisons = list(c("Endometrium","Endometriosis")))+
  facet_grid(~fov_type)+theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45,vjust = 1,hjust = 1),
        strip.background = element_blank(),strip.text.x = element_blank())+
    labs(x="",y="% per instance",size="Size")+
    scale_color_manual(values=cellcols)+guides(col="none")
#partB<-plot_grid(pB0,pB1,nrow=2,align = "v",axis = "lr",rel_heights = c(.3,.7))
#partA<-plot_grid(plot_grid(pA0,NULL,nrow=2,rel_heights = c(.75,.25)),partB,rel_widths = c(.25,.75))

temp<-temp%>%ungroup()%>%mutate(box=cut(total,breaks = 10))
formula <- y ~ x    
pC<-ggplot(temp, aes(x= total, y= prop, group=fov_type,color = fov_type)) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", formula = formula, se = F,)+
  scale_color_manual(values=cellcols)+labs(x="Size",y='%',colour="Cell type")+
  scale_y_continuous(limit=c(0,NA))+theme_classic()+
  facet_wrap(~Class,nrow=2,scales = "free",strip.position = "right")+scale_x_sqrt()+
  theme(legend.position="none",strip.background = element_blank())

```
# scRNA
```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(speckle)
library(limma)
library(ggrepel)
library(msigdbr)
library(clusterProfiler)

sc<-readRDS("data/fixed_annotated_aux.seurat.rds")
sc<-subset(sc,cells = which(sc$Class=="Peritoneal endometriosis"&
              !sc$harmonized_major_cell_type%in%c("Exclude","Erythrocytes")))
gc()
sc$has_LA<-ifelse(sc$LA_per_Sample>0,"LA+","LA-")
sc@meta.data<-sc@meta.data%>%
  mutate(nosub=str_remove(harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type," \\(.+"))%>%
  mutate(nosub=str_replace(nosub,"Memmo","Memo")%>%str_remove("Early "))
aux_table<-sc@meta.data
```
## UMAP 
```{r}

imm<-subset(sc,cells=which(str_detect(sc$nosub,"T-|Macro|B-|Dend|NK|Mas|Plas")))
imm<-FindVariableFeatures(imm)
imm<-RunPCA(temp)
imm<-RunUMAP(imm,dims = 1:10,repulsion.strength = 5)
coords<-sc@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings%>%
  as.data.frame()%>%rownames_to_column("barcode")
coords<-sc@meta.data%>%rownames_to_column("barcode")%>%
  select(barcode,has_LA,SampleName,
         nosub)%>%inner_join(coords)
pD<-coords%>%ggplot(aes(x=umap_1,y=umap_2,col=nosub))+
  geom_point(size=0.1)+
  scale_color_manual(values=alt_cellcols)+
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3),ncol = 1))+
  theme_light()+labs(x="UMAP 1",y="UMAP 2",col="")+theme(legend.position = "none")
pD2<-coords%>%ggplot(aes(x=umap_1,y=umap_2))+
    stat_density_2d(aes(fill = ..level..), geom = "polygon")+
    facet_grid(rows=vars(has_LA))+
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "B",direction = -1,labels=c("Min","Max"),breaks=c(0,.01))+
    theme_light()+theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
                        strip.text.y.right = element_text(colour ="black"))+
    labs(x="UMAP 1",y="UMAP 2")
```

## Speckle
```{r}
aux_table<-aux_table%>%filter(str_detect(nosub,"B|T-|NK|Macr|Plas|Dend|Mas"))
props<-getTransformedProps(aux_table$nosub,
                           aux_table$SampleName)
temp<-aux_table%>%distinct(has_LA,SampleName)
designM<-model.matrix(~0+has_LA,data=temp)#groups around 
colnames(designM)<-c("LAn","LAy")

props<-props$TransformedProps[,temp$SampleName]
fit<-lmFit(props,designM)
cont<-makeContrasts(LAy-LAn,levels = designM)
fit<-contrasts.fit(fit,cont)
fit <- eBayes(fit, robust=TRUE)
res<-topTable(fit,number = nrow(props),coef = 1)
#res<-res%>%mutate(FC=2**abs(logFC) * sign(logFC))

res<-res%>%arrange(logFC)%>%
  rownames_to_column("cell_type")%>%
  mutate(cell_type=factor(cell_type,levels=cell_type))
pE<-res%>%ggplot(aes(x=logFC,y=cell_type,col=logFC,size=P.Value))+
    geom_point()+geom_point(data=res%>%filter(adj.P.Val<0.05),shape=1,col="black")+
    scale_size(range=c(6,1),transform = "log10",breaks = c(.005,.05,.5))+
    scale_colour_gradient2(low = "#2166ac", mid = "#f7f7f7", high = "#b2182b")+
    theme_classic()+
    labs(x="LFC",y="")

#temp<-aux_table%>%count(has_LA,harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type,name = "cell_n")%>%
#    group_by(has_LA)%>%
#    mutate(total=sum(cell_n),prop=100*cell_n/total)
#temp<-temp%>%group_by(harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type)%>%summarise(cell_n=sum(cell_n),has_LA="Total")%>%ungroup()%>%mutate(total=sum(cell_n),prop=100*cell_n/total)%>%bind_rows(temp%>%mutate(has_LA=as.character(has_LA)))
#p0<-temp%>%ggplot(aes(y=cell_n,x=has_LA,fill=harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type))+geom_bar(stat="identity",position = "fill")+scale_fill_manual(values=unique(c(kelly.colours,cluster.cols)))

weird <- scales::trans_new("signed_log10",
       transform=function(x) sign(x)*log10(abs(x)),
       inverse=function(x) sign(x)*10**log10(abs(x)))

temp<-aux_table%>%count(has_LA,nosub)%>%
  group_by(nosub)%>%
  mutate(nosub=factor(nosub,levels = (pE$data$cell_type)),
         total=sum(n),
         prop=n/total)
pE1<-temp%>%mutate(nosub=factor(nosub,levels=rev(pE$data$cell_type)))%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=n,y=has_LA,fill=nosub))+
  geom_col()+scale_fill_manual(values=alt_cellcols)+

             scales="free",space="free",switch='y')+theme_classic()+

        axis.line.y = element_blank(),axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        plot.margin=grid::unit(c(0,3,0,-6), "mm"))+scale_x_log10()+
  labs(y="",x="Cells")
```

## Differential expression
```{r}
bulk<-AggregateExpression(
  sc,
  assays = "RNA",
  return.seurat = T,
  group.by = c("SampleName","nosub","has_LA"))

#i<-bulk@meta.data%>%count(nosub)%>%
#  filter(n>10)%>%distinct(nosub)%>%
#  unlist()
#all subsets include >100 cells from >10 samples
bulk<-lapply(unique(sc$nosub), function(x) 
  subset(bulk,subset =nosub==x ))
names(bulk)<-unique(sc$nosub)
deg<-lapply(bulk,function(x) 
  FindMarkers(x,group.by="has_LA",ident.1="LA+",
              ident.2="LA-",test.use="MAST",logfc.threshold=0))
deg<-lapply(names(deg),function(x) 
  deg[[x]]%>%rownames_to_column("gene")%>%mutate(ct=x))%>%bind_rows()
#write_csv(deg,"docs/has_laDEG-nosub_bulk-MAST.tsv")

ranks<-split(deg,f = deg$ct)%>%lapply(function(x) 
  x%>%add_count(gene)%>%filter(n==1)%>%arrange(desc(avg_log2FC))%>%
    distinct(gene,avg_log2FC)%>%deframe)

gsea_bp<-lapply(ranks,function(x) 
  gseGO(x,OrgDb = 'org.Hs.eg.db',seed = T,
        pvalueCutoff = 0.05,minGSSize = 50,
        ont = "BP",keyType = "SYMBOL"))
gsea_bp<-lapply(gsea_bp,simplify)

gsea_bp<-lapply(names(gsea_bp),function(x)
  gsea_bp[[x]]%>%as.data.frame()%>%mutate(ct=x))%>%bind_rows()
#gsea_bp%>%write_csv("docs/has_laDEG-nosubbulk-GSEA-BPsimpl.csv")


temp<-deg%>%filter(ct%in%pE$data$cell_type)%>%
  arrange(avg_log2FC)%>%group_by(ct)%>%mutate(index=1:n(),
           ct=factor(ct,levels=rev(pE$data$cell_type)))
temp<-temp%>%ungroup()%>%complete(ct,fill = list(avg_log2FC=0))
pF<-temp%>%ggplot(aes(x=index,y=ct,fill=avg_log2FC))+geom_raster()+
  facet_wrap(~ct,scales="free",nrow=30)+
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166ac",mid="#F5F5F5",high = "#b2182b")+
  theme_minimal()+theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
                        strip.text = element_blank(),
                        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
                        panel.spacing = unit(.02, "lines"),
                        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())+
  labs(x="Genes",y="cell types",fill="LFC")

temp<-gsea_bp%>%filter(ct%in%pE$data$cell_type)%>%
  mutate(STATUS=ifelse(NES>0,"LA+","LA-"),
                     ct=factor(ct,levels = pE$data$cell_type))%>%
    count(ct,STATUS)
temp<-temp%>%complete(ct,STATUS)
pG<-temp%>%ggplot(aes(x=STATUS,y=ct,fill=n))+
    geom_tile()+scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "B",
                    direction = -1,na.value = "white")+
    theme_classic()+theme(axis.line.y = element_blank(),
                          axis.ticks.y = element_blank())+
    labs(y="",fill="Enriched\nprocess")

i<-gsea_bp%>%filter(NES>0)%>%add_count(Description)%>%
  filter(n>4)%>%distinct(Description)%>%unlist()
temp<-gsea_bp%>%filter(Description%in%i&ct%in%pE$data$cell_type)%>%
  add_count(Description)%>%arrange(n,Description)%>%
  mutate(Description=factor(Description,levels=rev(unique(Description))),
         ct=factor(ct,levels = unique(ct)))
pH<-temp%>%ggplot(aes(x=ct,y=Description,size =p.adjust,col=NES))+geom_point()+
    theme_bw()+labs(x="",y="")+
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45,vjust = 1,hjust = 1))+
    scale_colour_gradient2(low = "#2166ac", mid = "#f7f7f7", high = "#b2182b")+
    scale_size(range=c(5,1))
pH1<-pH$data%>%distinct(ct)%>%ggplot(aes(x=ct,fill=ct,y=1))+geom_tile()+
  scale_fill_manual(values=alt_cellcols)+theme_void()+theme(legend.position = "n")
i<-gsea_bp%>%filter(NES<0)%>%add_count(Description)%>%
    filter(n>4)%>%distinct(Description)%>%unlist()
temp<-gsea_bp%>%filter(Description%in%i&ct%in%pE$data$cell_type)%>%
  add_count(Description)%>%arrange(n,Description)%>%
  mutate(Description=factor(Description,levels=rev(unique(Description))),
         ct=factor(ct,levels = unique(ct)))
pI<-temp%>%ggplot(aes(x=ct,y=Description,size =p.adjust,col=NES))+geom_point()+
    theme_bw()+labs(x="",y="")+
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45,vjust = 1,hjust = 1))+
    scale_colour_gradient2(low = "#2166ac", mid = "#f7f7f7", high = "#b2182b")+
    scale_size(range=c(5,1))
pI1<-pI$data%>%distinct(ct)%>%ggplot(aes(x=ct,fill=ct,y=1))+geom_tile()+
  scale_fill_manual(values=alt_cellcols)+theme_void()+theme(legend.position = "n")



partA<-plot_grid(NULL,pA,pC,nrow=3,rel_heights = c(.2,.4,.4))
partB<-plot_grid(NULL,pB0,pB1+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=0,vjust = 1,hjust = .5)),nrow=3,rel_heights = c(.45,.15,.4),align = "v",axis = "lr")
partA<-plot_grid(partB,partA,rel_widths = c(.75,.25))
partD<-plot_grid(plot_grid(pD,NULL,nrow = 2),pD2+theme(legend.position = "bottom"))
partB<-plot_grid(pE+theme(legend.position = "left"),pE1+theme(strip.text.y.left = element_blank()),pF+theme(axis.text.y = element_blank()),pG+theme(axis.text.y = element_blank()),ncol=4,align = "h",axis = "tb",rel_widths = c(.45,.1,.23,.17))
partC<-plot_grid(plot_grid(pH+theme(axis.text.x = element_blank()),pH1,nrow = 2,rel_heights = c(.9,.1),align = "v",axis = "lr"),plot_grid(pI+theme(axis.text.x = element_blank()),pI1,nrow=2,rel_heights = c(.9,.1),align = "v",axis = "lr"),align = "h",axis = "tb")
```

# Metabolism
```{r}
library(scMetabolism)
sc<-readRDS("/media/Lawrenson_Lab_NAS/caipirinha/speed/share/fixed_annotated_aux.seurat.rds")
sc<-subset(sc,cells = which(sc$Class=="Peritoneal endometriosis"))
sc$has_LA<-sc$LA_per_Sample>0

#can't get it working with vision or ssgsea
sc<-sc.metabolism.Seurat(obj = sc, method = "VISION",
                         imputation = F, ncores = 6, metabolism.type = "KEGG")
#scmetabo<-sc@

scmetabo<-scmetabo%>%
  mutate(across(`Glycolysis / Gluconeogenesis`:`Drug metabolism - other enzymes`,function(x) 100*x))
temp<-split(scmetabo,by = "harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type")
designM<-lapply(temp,function(x) model.matrix(~0+has_LA,data=x))#groups around 
fit<-lapply(names(temp),function(x) 
  lmFit(temp[[x]]%>%select(1,4:88)%>%
          column_to_rownames("Cell")%>%t(),designM[[x]]))
names(fit)<-names(temp)
cont<-lapply(designM,function(x) makeContrasts(has_LATRUE-has_LAFALSE,levels = x))
fit<-lapply(names(temp),function(x) contrasts.fit(fit[[x]],cont[[x]]))
fit <- lapply(fit,function(x) eBayes(x, robust=TRUE))

res<-lapply(fit,function(x) topTable(x,number = 85,coef = 1))
names(res)<-names(temp)
res<-lapply(names(res),function(x) 
  res[[x]]%>%mutate(celltype=x)%>%
    rownames_to_column("pathway"))%>%bind_rows()

i<-scmetabo%>%count(harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type,has_LA)%>%
  filter(n<100)%>%distinct(harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type)%>%unlist()
j<-res%>%group_by(pathway)%>%summarise(logFC=mean(logFC))%>%slice_min(logFC,n=5)
j<-res%>%group_by(pathway)%>%summarise(logFC=mean(logFC))%>%slice_max(logFC,n=5)%>%bind_rows(j)
j<-j%>%arrange(logFC)
pJ<-res%>%filter(pathway%in%j$pathway&str_detect(celltype,"EnS|EnEp|theli|Mesen|Smoot",negate = T))%>%
    mutate(pathway=factor(pathway,levels=j$pathway))%>%
    ggplot(aes(y=pathway,x=logFC))+geom_density_ridges(alpha=0.1)+
    #geom_jitter(aes(col=celltype,size= adj.P.Val),height = .1,alpha=0.5)+
    theme_classic()+#scale_color_manual(values=alt_cellcols)+
    theme(axis.line.y = element_blank(),axis.ticks.y = element_blank())+scale_size(range=c(6,.5))+
    guides(colour = "none")+geom_vline(xintercept = 0)


partA<-plot_grid(pA1+theme(legend.position = "none"),pA2+theme(legend.position = "bottom"),pB+theme(legend.position = "bottom",axis.text.x = element_text(angle=0)),pBA,pF,ncol=5,rel_widths = c(.2,.2,.2,.15,.3),align = 'h',axis = 'tb')
partB<-plot_grid(pC,pD,pE,pG,ncol=4,align = "h",axis = 'tb',rel_widths = c(.2,.15,.45,.2))
```
